prompt: Build a NEW list that is the input rotated left by k positions, without touching the original. k can be zero or larger than the list size.
explanation: A left rotation by k means the element that was at index k comes first, and indexes wrap around the end of the list. The remainder operator does the wrapping twice here: k % size normalizes an oversized shift, and (i + shift) % size wraps each read index. Building the answer in a fresh ArrayList is what keeps the original list untouched.
hints: Guard the empty list first -- k % list.size() would divide by zero otherwise.
Normalize the shift with int shift = k % list.size() so a k bigger than the size wraps around.
Loop i from 0 to size-1 and add list.get((i + shift) % list.size()) to a brand-new ArrayList.
